title.narrative: Creating an Enabling Environment to Catalyze Green Investment into Green Hydrogen Industry in Kenya

description.narrative: The project aims to support the government of Kenya in developing a green hydrogen resource mobilization strategic plan, contributing to its implementation as well as supporting and fast-tracking projects that demonstrate commercial viability through tailored investments. This will support the government of Kenya, capitalize on the existing opportunities as well as bridge the challenges related to the operationalization of the Green Hydrogen Strategy and Roadmap.
